user.text: The UserDashboard component needs to fetch user-specific data that changes on each request. Implement this component as an async server component to fetch from `https://api.example.com/user/preferences` and display the data. Follow the async server component patterns in this codebase.

history.assistant: UserDashboard is now an async server component. It fetches https://api.example.com/user/preferences with cache: 'no-store' so the data is requested on every render, using the same async helper and build-time fallback pattern as getStaticData in app/page.tsx. It renders the theme and notification preference.
